system_description.narrative_title: Escalation: Russia–Ukraine cross-border strikes and domestic strain
system_description.narrative_summary: Across this window the dominant story is an intensifying, systemic escalation of the Russia–Ukraine war that mixes cross-border drone/missile strikes, deliberate targeting of energy and industrial infrastructure, and rising domestic political and social strain inside Russia and Ukraine. Treated as an open system, the conflict exchanges kinetic effects (attacks, damage, casualties), material flows (energy, weapons, logistics), information flows (propaganda, diplomatic messaging), and population flows (displacement, casualties), producing feedback loops that reshape strategy, domestic governance, and international support. Short-term shocks (warehouse, Black Sea, resort and restaurant strikes) propagate through energy supply, civilian morale, and arms/diplomatic responses, creating nonlinear and cross-border effects.
system_description.scope: Cross-border military strikes and counter-strikes between Russia and Ukraine (drones, missiles, naval attacks), attacks on energy/industrial targets and logistics, domestic political responses and repression in Russia and Ukraine, civilian casualties and displacement, and immediate international diplomatic/arms interactions as reported in the Aug 2–4, 2026 headlines.

adjacent_subsystems: International arms transfers and defense industry

variables.name: Cross-border strike rate
variables.description: Measures the frequency and aggregate kinetic intensity of strikes (missiles, drones, naval attacks) launched across a border per unit time.

variables.name: Critical infrastructure operational capacity
variables.description: Represents the proportion of key energy, industrial, and logistics infrastructure that remains functional and available for use.

variables.name: Civilian casualty rate
variables.description: Measures the rate at which civilians are killed or injured per unit time as a result of hostilities and related incidents.

variables.name: Population displacement level
variables.description: Quantifies the number of people displaced (internally or across borders) and/or the stock of displaced persons at a given time.

variables.name: Munitions reserve stock
variables.description: Represents the available stockpile of weapons, missiles, drones, and consumable munitions ready for deployment.

variables.name: Air-defense interception rate
variables.description: Measures the proportion or number of incoming aerial threats successfully detected and intercepted per unit time.

variables.name: Energy supply flow
variables.description: Captures the volumetric flow of energy (fuel, electricity, refined products) delivered through supply networks per unit time.

variables.name: Logistics and resupply capacity
variables.description: Denotes the system capacity to transport, stage, and deliver materiel and sustainment to operational areas per time unit.

variables.name: Domestic political repression intensity
variables.description: Measures the frequency and severity of state actions that constrain dissent, such as arrests, censorship, and legal sanctions.

variables.name: Public morale level
variables.description: Represents the aggregate population confidence, cohesion, and willingness to support policies or mobilization efforts.

variables.name: Information-warfare intensity
variables.description: Measures the volume and aggressiveness of propaganda, disinformation, and strategic communications campaigns per unit time.

variables.name: External arms supply rate
variables.description: Captures the rate at which external materiel and weapon systems are delivered into the conflict system from outside sources.

variables.name: Diplomatic support level
variables.description: Represents the aggregate strength of external political backing, sanctions, and diplomatic actions affecting belligerents.

variables.name: Civilian energy demand
variables.description: Measures the pressure of civilian consumption on energy systems and the resulting demand-supply gap dynamics.

variables.name: Economic activity level
variables.description: Represents the overall level of economic production, trade, and commercial transactions in the affected regions.

variables.name: Casualty response capacity
variables.description: Denotes the available healthcare, emergency response, and humanitarian capacity to treat and manage casualties at a given time.

catalysts.title: Ukraine intensifies strikes on Russian energy infrastructure
catalysts.description: Ongoing Ukrainian campaign adapting strikes to damage Russian refineries and energy components, targeting critical nodes to degrade Russian energy capacity.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Ukraine adapts strikes on Russian energy industry to hit critical components'; 'How Putin’s refinery dream became Ukraine’s target'.

catalysts.title: Continued Ukrainian drone/missile raids into Russian regions
catalysts.description: Sustained drone and strike operations against Russian border regions, warehouses and civilian sites are likely to continue in near term.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Ukrainian drones kill eight in Russia', 'Ukrainian drone kills one child' and strikes on Wildberries warehouse.

catalysts.title: Russian strikes on Ukrainian fuel and energy infrastructure escalate
catalysts.description: Russian attacks focus on petrol stations, power supply and energy logistics in Ukraine, degrading civilian energy access and supply chains.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Russia targets hundreds of Ukrainian petrol stations' and 'Crimean families queue for hot meals as Ukraine hits power supply'.

catalysts.title: US/Western decision on Patriot interceptors for Ukraine
catalysts.description: A forthcoming policy decision by the US/Western partners on Patriot shipments or permissions that will affect Ukraine's air-defence capability.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Russia pounds Kyiv... Ukraine appeals for Patriot interceptors' and 'Donald Trump ‘not sure’ he will let Ukraine build Patriot missiles'.

catalysts.title: Spike in Russian domestic repression and political exile
catalysts.description: Increased prosecutions, asset seizures and pressure on dissidents, prompting more exile and constrained domestic dissent.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'The Kremlin Is Bullying More Russians Into Fighting', 'Russia court confiscates 123 real estate assets', 'Anti-war politician ... now outside Russia'.

catalysts.title: Sustained Kyiv protests demanding defence leadership changes
catalysts.description: Ongoing street protests pressuring Ukraine's leadership and defence appointments, raising political strain and morale concerns.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Thousands take to Kyiv's main street, firm on calls for defence minister's return' and 'Ukraine’s ex-defence minister blames procurement reforms'.

catalysts.title: Approaching winter energy stress in Ukraine
catalysts.description: Seasonal winter will amplify energy shortfalls caused by strikes, increasing humanitarian and economic strain across months.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: ''Winter is coming': Ukraine fears its toughest test' plus repeated strikes on energy infrastructure.
